# Mastermind Council

> Mastermind Council (council.dravec.org) is a web app for thinking through a decision with
> advisers modelled on historical thinkers: Seneca, Marcus Aurelius, Socrates, Confucius,
> Benjamin Franklin, the Buddha and Maria Montessori (the Classics roster), or simulations
> inspired by Peter Drucker, Steve Jobs and Andy Grove with Socrates (the Business roster). A
> neutral facilitator runs the session. It ends in a journal entry you keep: the decision, its
> reasoning and assumptions, and one next action with an optional dated commitment and email
> reminder. In private beta in October 2026: the app asks for a password.

## What is different
- Quotes are checked. Each Classics adviser draws on named public-domain editions (Gummere's
  Seneca, Long's Marcus Aurelius, Jowett's Plato, Legge's Analects, Müller's Dhammapada and
  Sujato's suttas, Anne E. George's Montessori, Franklin's Autobiography and Way to Wealth).
  A quotation an adviser makes is checked against the source passages before it is shown; one
  that cannot be found is removed.
- "Last time…": your earlier decisions and open commitments open the next session (kept in the
  browser, or in your account when signed in).
- One shared question a day, the same for everyone.
- Talk mode: a spoken conversation, each adviser in a distinct synthetic voice.
- Works inside Claude or ChatGPT as an MCP connector: https://llm.dravec.org/mcp (OAuth sign-in
  by email).

## Honest caveats
- The advisers are AI simulations, not the historical people, and not endorsed by them or their
  estates. Business-roster advisers are "inspired by" and do not quote their namesakes at length.
- No medical, legal or financial advice. The council refuses hate, self-harm and medical
  requests and offers no religious absolution.
- Not affiliated with any Montessori organisation or estate.
- No paid plan yet. Anonymous visitors get one session; signed-in free accounts have daily limits.
- What is stored and for how long: https://council.dravec.org/privacy
